threads.title: Write the big dream, then specify the daily work
threads.dateProvenance: Canonical X root displays Oct 25, 2026; six continuations display Oct 25.
threads.summary: Bowman uses Phelps' early goal sheet to separate a large motivating dream from seasonal targets and specific practice actions. Write the ambition down, keep it visible, and turn it into a small action you can take next.

posts.summary: Recalls an early goal sheet from Phelps that separated the stated Olympic goal from a more ambitious private dream.
Describes the dream of Olympic gold that Phelps wrote and crossed out.
Explains that a distant ambition can motivate a young athlete before it seems attainable.
Breaks the goal sheet into a dream, a seasonal target and concrete practice actions.
Contrasts a broad motivating dream with precise daily goals.
Uses a visible goal sheet to keep the goal present in everyday life.
Encourages writing down the large ambition and then taking the first small action.
